extra_context: We're Static Vanguard, a competitive gaming team running rosters in Valorant and Rocket League, and we're trying to grow from grassroots into a real org with sponsors. The site needs to serve our fans who follow our match schedule and clips, but honestly it's also a pitch deck for brands — we want it to feel loud, fast, and electric the second someone lands on it. The one thing that's actually ours: every player has a signature "static glitch" intro animation we run before their matches, and fans have started making it our whole identity. Make it feel like walking into the arena right before the crowd goes off.
